nodes.description: address owner; privileged account stored by Ownable, set to msg.sender in the constructor and rewritten by transferOwnership.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner; moves ownership after rejecting the zero address.
msg.sender; untrusted caller identity used for ownership checks and as the key into balances/allowed mappings.
mapping(address => uint256) balances; token balances of every holder.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed; ERC20 spend allowances.
uint256 totalSupply_; total token supply, mutable by mint/burn and initialised in the FindBitToken constructor.
StandardToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value); validates address and balance then moves funds.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value); moves funds using both balance and allowance checks.
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value); overwrites the caller's allowance for a spender.
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender) view; reads the allowed mapping.
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue); adds to the caller's allowance via SafeMath.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue); subtracts from the allowance, clamping at zero.
StandardToken.totalSupply() view; returns totalSupply_.
StandardToken.balanceOf(address _owner) view; returns balances[_owner].
bool paused = false; emergency stop flag read by the whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers.
Pausable.pause() onlyOwner whenNotPaused; sets paused = true.
Pausable.unpause() onlyOwner whenPaused; sets paused = false.
PausableToken.transfer override gated by whenNotPaused that delegates to super.transfer.
PausableToken.transferFrom override gated by whenNotPaused that delegates to super.transferFrom.
PausableToken.approve override gated by whenNotPaused that delegates to super.approve.
PausableToken.increaseApproval override gated by whenNotPaused that delegates to super.increaseApproval.
PausableToken.decreaseApproval override gated by whenNotPaused that delegates to super.decreaseApproval.
string public name; token display name, mutable through setTokenInfo.
string public symbol; token ticker, mutable through setTokenInfo.
uint8 public decimals = 18; used to scale the initial supply.
mapping(address => Schedule) freezed; per-address vesting schedule with amount, start, cliff, duration, released and lastReleased.
FindBitToken constructor; mints 50,000,000 * 10**decimals to msg.sender and assigns owner.
FindBitToken.setTokenInfo(string _name, string _symbol) onlyOwner; rewrites the token metadata.
FindBitToken.freezeOf(address _owner) view; returns the frozen amount of an address.
FindBitToken.freeze(uint256 _value, uint256 _duration); locks the caller's own tokens into a schedule using block.timestamp.
FindBitToken.freezeFrom(address _who, uint256 _value, uint256 _cliff, uint256 _duration) onlyOwner; locks tokens of a third party.
FindBitToken.unfreeze(address _who); time-based release that computes vested amounts using block.timestamp and SafeMath division.
FindBitToken.mint(address _to, uint256 _value) onlyOwner; inflates totalSupply_ and credits a balance.
FindBitToken.burn(address _who, uint256 _value) onlyOwner; destroys tokens and reduces totalSupply_.
block.timestamp; miner-influenced time source driving freeze/cliff/release accounting.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 _x, uint256 _y); multiplication guarded by an overflow assertion.
SafeMath.div(uint256 _x, uint256 _y); integer division with no zero/rounding guard.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 _x, uint256 _y); subtraction guarded by an underflow assertion.
SafeMath.add(uint256 _x, uint256 _y); addition guarded by an overflow assertion.
assert(z / _x == _y) overflow check inside SafeMath.mul; assert failure consumes all gas.
Vested amount computation in unfreeze: mul/sub/div chain whose result depends on block.timestamp and truncates on division.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner modifier of transferOwnership.
owner state variable is read by onlyOwner before allowing transferOwnership.
_newOwner parameter is assigned to the owner state variable.
transferOwnership rewrites the privileged owner state variable.
constructor stores msg.sender as the initial owner and initial balance holder.
FindBitToken constructor initialises owner through Ownable.
constructor assigns totalSupply_ from decimals.
constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
totalSupply() reads totalSupply_.
totalSupply() is called on the StandardToken holding balances.
balanceOf reads balances[_owner].
transfer reads the sender and recipient balances for validation.
transfer writes the updated sender and recipient balances.
_to parameter receives the transferred value.
_value parameter drives the balance update in transfer.
msg.sender is the debited account and the trusted caller of transfer.
transferFrom reads balances[_from] and balances[_to].
transferFrom writes the updated balances.
transferFrom reads allowed[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom decrements the consumed allowance.
_from parameter identifies the debited account.
_to parameter receives the funds.
_value parameter drives balance and allowance updates.
msg.sender must be the approved spender in allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approve sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
increaseApproval reads and writes the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval stores the increased allowance.
decreaseApproval reads the existing allowance.
decreaseApproval stores the reduced or zeroed allowance.
increaseApproval keys the allowance by msg.sender.
decreaseApproval keys the allowance by msg.sender.
pause reads the paused flag through whenNotPaused.
pause sets paused = true.
unpause reads the paused flag through whenPaused.
unpause sets paused = false.
onlyOwner reads owner to authorise pause.
onlyOwner reads owner to authorise unpause.
require(msg.sender == owner) in the onlyOwner modifier gates pause.
require(msg.sender == owner) in the onlyOwner modifier gates unpause.

PausableToken.decreaseApproval delegates to super.decreaseApproval.
whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before transfer.
whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before transferFrom.
whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before approve.

whenNotPaused modifier requires !paused before decreaseApproval.
setTokenInfo reads the current name before overwriting it.
setTokenInfo reads the current symbol before overwriting it.
_name parameter is written into the name state variable.
_symbol parameter is written into the symbol state variable.
setTokenInfo writes the name state variable.
setTokenInfo writes the symbol state variable.
onlyOwner reads owner to authorise setTokenInfo.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates setTokenInfo.
freezeOf reads freezed[_owner].amount.
freeze reads balances[msg.sender] to validate the amount.
freeze subtracts the frozen value from balances[msg.sender].
freeze reads the existing schedule of the caller.
freeze overwrites freezed[msg.sender] with a new Schedule.
_value parameter becomes the scheduled amount and the debited balance.
_duration parameter becomes the schedule duration.
block.timestamp is captured into start, cliff and lastReleased fields.
freeze keys the schedule and balance by msg.sender.
freezeFrom reads balances[_who] for validation.
freezeFrom subtracts the locked value from balances[_who].
freezeFrom reads the current schedule entry.
freezeFrom writes a new Schedule (note: into freezed[msg.sender] while debiting _who).
_who parameter selects the debited account.
_value parameter is the locked amount.
_cliff parameter is added to the start timestamp.
_duration parameter sets the vesting duration.
block.timestamp determines start, cliff and lastReleased in freezeFrom.
onlyOwner reads owner to authorise freezeFrom.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates freezeFrom.
unfreeze loads the Schedule of _who from freezed.
unfreeze updates released, lastReleased and amount on the schedule.
unfreeze reads balances[_who] before crediting the released amount.
unfreeze adds the released amount to balances[_who].
_who parameter selects the schedule and balance to release.
block.timestamp is compared with cliff and used in the vesting formula.
unfreeze executes the mul/sub/div release computation that can truncate or mis-account vested value.
block.timestamp selects which branch of the release maths is executed.
mint reads totalSupply_ before increasing it.
mint writes the increased totalSupply_.
mint reads balances[_to].
mint credits balances[_to].
_to parameter receives minted tokens.
_value parameter is the minted amount.
onlyOwner reads owner to authorise mint.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates mint.
burn reads balances[_who] for validation.
burn subtracts the burned value from balances[_who].
burn reads totalSupply_ before reducing it.
burn writes the reduced totalSupply_.
_who parameter selects the burned account.
_value parameter is the burned amount.
onlyOwner reads owner to authorise burn.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates burn.
SafeMath.mul performs the overflow assertion on the product.
transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balances and allowance.
increaseApproval uses SafeMath.add on the allowance.
decreaseApproval uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
freeze uses SafeMath.add for the cliff timestamp.
freeze uses SafeMath.sub on the caller balance.
freezeFrom uses SafeMath.add for the cliff timestamp.
unfreeze uses SafeMath.add when accumulating released amounts and balances.
unfreeze uses SafeMath.sub for elapsed time and schedule bookkeeping.
unfreeze uses SafeMath.div, which truncates the vested proportional amount.
mint uses SafeMath.add on totalSupply_ and balances.
burn uses SafeMath.sub on balances and totalSupply_.
